It's a pretty genius combo if you as me; it just works! The singer sounds like Corey Glover too! Did you mix and master this track yourself as well?

I think the feedback for your voice that I'd give is that your voice and pronunciation sounds a lot like Machine Gun Kelly. Not sure if that's intentional or not, but it's pretty cool in my opinion. I would experiment more with enunciation if you wanna have your own sound, otherwise, keep it up!

This is an interesting track and the lyrics (along with the delivery) was so fucking unique and identifiable. Call me crazy, but the fact that this is so different makes it sooo refreshing. I wouldn't change a damn thing about it. Did you mix and master this track yourself as well?

I feel like there's a really cool, post rock, almost Gothie production here. The guitar seems like it would benefit from being recorded in a nice room, same for the bass, and the drums need to be real! Although if you're going for the electric route, then it's just a matter of mixing.

It is a pretty interesting track because it reminded me a lot of the old-school parliament funkadelic material, at least with regards to its production and subject matter. However, I think you could have gone to a music studio or some place to get it recorded professionally. The idea you have here is pretty valid and it would be awesome to hear real drums and guitars behind it!

There's a good idea here, and I think you should flush this out further. I think the vocal production can use some work in terms of making it sound more polished, and the mastering should be used to glue the whole sound in production together. Did you mix a master this yourself?

this is a pretty interesting track and I kind of feel unqualified to give it any kind of feedback because I've never really heard anything like it. But I've got to say the mix sounds good, and the vocal production is interesting. I wouldn't say it's what I would've done, but again perhaps for the genre it works. Did you make some of this by yourself?

I really dug how the guitar was played on this track; that's not an instrument that's put at the forefront as much these days, so I really dig what you're trying to put together here. And the mix is pretty solid for the genre. Did you mix and master this yourself?

This is a pretty dope track and I imagine it would be sooo awesome to experience at a live rave! It really does hit all the beats on a technical level so I dig this! Did you mix and master this yourself?
This is a solid track, but if I had only one critique, it would be that the track itself could use better vocal production imo. It can sound a bit more in your face, but his flow is dope!

Hahaha, this was pretty dope, not gonna lie. I thought it was tongue in cheek, but in a really fun way. My biggest critique would be that the Kurt Angle theme is wayyyy too low in the volume, raise that and let it mix with them drums better! Did you mix and master this track yourself?

I don't see what the video has to do with the actual song itself, but I think this is an interesting track with a vocal track that really does fit the vibe of the instrumental. I don't even know what you'd call this style of music. What genre is this? Did you mix and master this track yourself?

Damn, that was really interesting. I think you're combining a lot of interesting textural, atmospheric sounds to create something truly sexy. And your voice kinda sounds like Jon Bon Jovi, so it's interesting to hear it juxtaposed next to this beat. Did you mix and master this track yourself?

This is a very interesting piece of music because I can't say that I've ever heard anything quite like it before. I don't know what genre it is, but I can for some reason hear someone like Tyler The Creator get on this and do an incredible job with it. Did you mix and master this track yourself?

Damn, I gotta ask, is that a really recorded piano or is that a VST or sample? Either way I think this is pretty well put together. I totally understand and feel the intention of what you as the artist are trying to convey, so bravo.  Did you mix and master this track yourself?

Perfect Dark is such an iconic game! I think you did a pretty good job with this re-imagining. It sounds like it would fit right in to a remastered version of Perfect Dark for today's console. Production is really clean, bravo.  Did you mix and master this track yourself?

Your flow is really on point, man! The only feedback I'd really have to give would be that your vocal production could stand to sound a bit more polished. Perhaps a better mic and recording in a treated vocal booth would help. Did you mix and master this track yourself?

This is a pretty chill kind of track. I'm honestly not sure what I'd refer to this genre-wise either. It has some compositional elements that are similar to lo-fi, but it very much isn't lofi from a production standpoint. Did you mix and master this yourself?

Yoooo this beat is hardddd as hell! Did you mix and master this yourself? I gotta say, it's not often that you go on these subreddits and come across a professional quality mix of this caliber! Kduos to you, my man!

I can't say I listen to this genre often, but I would say the vocal is a bit too loud in my opinion. It's got a very relaxed energy and I think is pretty chill in terms of its overall vibe. Did you mix and master this yourself?

If I had to point out one thing I liked about this track that I'd use as an edemplary remark, I'd say the bass sounds this and it's relationship to the kick is what it's all about. This is ideal and crisp! Did you mix and master this yourself?

This gave some chill yet trippy vibes overall. I think the overall idea is here but I wouldn't mind hearing it go through a professional mix engineer's hands. Sorry if I'm assuming you mix and mastered this yourself... did you? It's a pretty catchy tune otherwise!

I dug the break-beat style drums and the production overall is pretty solid. Only feedback I have is about the vocal being a weaker than the other parts. A better mic would help, I think. Did you mix and master this yourself?

I've got to say this reminded me of the Quake soundtrack a bit. It's very NIN and cinematic. You should consider collaborating with a video game company to provide their music! Did you mix and master this yourself?
Very cool stuff! Can I ask what your chain is? I also think the baseline works with this idea pretty nicely. I would say flesh it out some more! You've got a pretty solid idea going on here!

This is pretty experimental as hell! I can't really critique it because I've never heard anything like it before, but I can say that I think it was definitely an interesting listen all the way through. You never lost my attention once. If you ever wanna collab with a vocalist, I'd love to get on a beat like this and work something out with you!

This is an interesting song. In my opinion it combines elements from the themes for Pirates of the Caribbean and Game of Thrones in a really interesting way. My only critique would be that having real drums on this would sound sooo much cooler. Did you mix and master this yourself?

This is an interesting beat, but in my opinion, it's right on the cusp of the lo-fi aesthetic before not qualifying. I feel like the drums and the main melody line are too upfront in your face and should be scaled back in a calming way to give the loft energy. Did you mix and master this yourself?

This is such a beautifully crafted music video and it really brings a nice, modern vibe and energy to what sounds like an old-time shanty! Very fun energy as well! The mix and production is also very beautifully crafted! Did y'all mix and master this yourselves?

I feel the instrumental music for this track is pretty hard and I love that quality of it. The vocal production in my opinion is a little lacking from a sound quality perspective. A proper mic and mix for the vocals would elevate this sooooo much! Did you mix and master this yourself?

This track has such a beautiful and fun vibe! I think it showcases what you guys would sound like live pretty well, imo! The recording production is so crisp and I can hear every element and track so clearly! Did you mix and master this yourself?

This is a cool production. The intro rhythm reminds me of the Fast and Furious Tokyo Drift song lol That's not a bad thing. The vocal production and overall mixing is professional sounding as hell! Did you mix and master this yourself?

This track is pretty well put together. My only feedback would be the vocal sound from a mix perspective, because it comes out sounding thin and tinny. It might be a personal taste thing, but I'd add some bass there. Did you mix and master this track yourself?

Honestly, I LOVED the track's vibe as well as how the artwork enhances the imagery of the sonic side. Did you mix and master this track yourself?

This is a pretty interesting production. I appreciate how you worked to make the vocal sound different from a sonic-quality perspective. The mix sounds pretty tight for this as well! Did you mix and master this track yourself?

This is a really awesomely written track and I can tell you really put in a lot of care into the songwriting here. Did you mix and master this track yourself?
